UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Trade Square enterprise or regional partner profile stored per Firebase Auth user.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the account owner.

accountType.description: Account classification: Rwandan business or regional partner.

tin.description: RRA 9-digit Tax Identification Number or regional partner tax ID.

rdbNumber.description: RDB enterprise registration code or regional incorporation number.

businessName.description: Registered legal name of the enterprise or partner organization.

contactPerson.description: Full name of the authorized managing director or trade representative.

email.description: Verified corporate email address of the user.

district.description: Rwandan operational district or regional commercial city.

commercialHub.description: Special Economic Zone, industrial park, or OSBP trade hub.

sectorCategory.description: Primary industry or trade service sector.

specificOfferings.description: Detailed description of exported goods or trade services.

products.description: Bounded list of up to 10 HS codes in the enterprise portfolio.

certifications.description: Bounded list of up to 10 quality and standards certifications.

monthlyCapacityKg.description: Monthly export or logistics capacity in kilograms.

exWorksPriceRwf.description: Ex-works unit price in Rwandan Francs (RWF/kg).

savedPartnerIds.description: Bounded list of up to 10 shortlisted regional partner IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores the authenticated user's dynamic RDB/Partner enterprise profile, TIN, products, certifications, and saved shortlist partners. Strictly isolated per owner UID.
